We tackle industrial electrical installations, advanced automation systems, and renewable energy solutions. Since our founding as a family-owned company in 1988, we've grown while staying true to our core values. Starting your career with KE means joining a culture that values your contributions, moves quickly, takes calculated risks, and celebrates team members who step up and own their work. If you're ready to join a team where your voice matters, your growth is supported, and your impact is celebrated, KE is the place for you. Job Purpose Primary responsibilities consist of but are not limited to installation and maintenance of overhead distribution conductors and equipment. Lineman will be expected to participate in underground construction, as well as performing large equipment removal or setting, including but not limited to pad mount transformer What You Will Do Construction of 15, 25, 35 kV poles MV Cable terminations including live front, load break and dead break Must presently have a working knowledge of all phases of Distribution and Transmission Construction, Maintenance and Operating. Experience with bucket trucks, digger derricks, trenchers and groundwork with utility line crew required. Ability to work on tight deadlines under pressure. Competency in Microsoft applications: Word, Excel, and Outlook. Manage project files, drawings, documents & records in our project system. Ability to create/view a site layout from construction drawings. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Willing to work occasional evenings, weekends, and holidays. Ability to travel for extended periods of time, out of town, and work unpredictable hours. Ability to work outdoors in all types of weather conditions. Additional duties as assigned. Qualifications What You Bring: The requirements listed in job descriptions are guidelines, not fixed rules. You do not have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If you feel you are an excellent candidate, we encourage you to apply! 5+ years of Medium Voltage experience. Eagerness to advance to the next level and assist in the growth of the team. Good critical thinking skills and the capability to troubleshoot and make logical project-minded decisions. Knowledge of electrical construction. Self-starter and team player. Must be available to travel extensively (up to 100%) within regional states, including overnight stays for up to weeks at a time if required. Possess and maintain a valid driver’s license that represents a history of safe & competent driving. Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check. Class A CDL Preferred. Total Rewards Statement As a full-time employee at KE, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and future. 100% employer-paid health and dental coverage for employees HSA contributions to support your medical expenses Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage 401(k) with competitive company match Performance-based incentives Paid weekly with competitive wages PTO, six paid holidays, and education reimbursement Exclusive employee discounts through Working Advantage The hourly range for this position is $30.00 - $40.00 per hour , which reflects a good-faith estimate based on market data and internal equity. We believe your work should be rewarded with more than just a paycheck. At KE, we invest in your total wellbeing. Physical Requirements Must be able to sit, stand, kneel, stoop, walk, and sit for long periods of time Must be capable of working in inclement conditions to include extreme hot and cold temperatures. Must be physically capable of manually digging & back-filling holes and trenches. Must be physically capable of lifting and carrying up to 80 lbs. Accessibility: If you need accommodations as part of the employment process, please contact Knobelsdorff Human Resources via email at HR@KEway.com. Applicants Have Rights Under Federal Employment Laws EEO is the Law (English/Spanish) KE E-Verify KE participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please review the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters . If you need accommodation during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll work with you.
